comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-004 (epic-136-phase4-mcp), populated only after reports/quality-gate/20260729T134641Z-epic-136-phase4-mcp-T-004.md recorded VERDICT: PASS (review-context reservation sequence 385 in reports/review-context/identity-ledger.json; 0 Critical / 0 Major / 3 Minor, every Minor classified Accepted by the evaluator). risk: high, required_workflow: tdd, stack: code. Routes evidence_find_missing's failed quality-gate directory scan to a new `required` `undeterminable` array so a scan failure is no longer indistinguishable from a genuine absence, with the genuinely-empty case pinned unreclassified by the unmodified pre-existing fixture (security-spec.md B4's named negative regression, AC-007/008). Being the last schema-touching task it also completes AC-009 by asserting all 3 new required fields and the unchanged $id together. Landing commits: bb31d9ac + 6ca2833a. The evaluator ran 4 mutation tests and recorded one Cannot-Verify -- whether an impl-review round covers the post-d55ed3ef landed code -- which this contract resolves: the independent-review verdict of record is the evaluator's own, carried as review_verdict in T-004.evidence.json per quality-gate SKILL.md:176-178, and it was produced against HEAD as landed. The lint/typecheck/build/placeholder-scan/task-state-check/unit-tests/acceptance-tests/regression/requirement-traceability evidence logs under specs/epic-136-phase4-mcp/verification/qg/ were executed ONCE at HEAD aeaea6b2 -- the commit at which all 5 tasks have landed -- and are therefore referenced by all 5 contracts. This is deliberate and disclosed: T-001..T-004 all edit mcp/sdd-forge-mcp/src/tools/evidence.ts, the v1 schema and the committed dist/index.js, so a per-task re-run at each task's own commit would measure a tree that no longer exists on this branch. Each task's own per-commit red/green/dist-parity evidence is separate and unshared (specs/epic-136-phase4-mcp/verification/<task>/). placeholder-scan evidence records BOTH runs. Run A (all 7 changed production files) exits 1 with 8 findings; Run A' repeats the identical command over the identical 7 paths' content at the merge base 7f152ce5 and reproduces the SAME 8 findings -- measured delta introduced by this feature: ZERO. Provenance was read, not assumed: 5 are inside CHANGELOG.md's RELEASED history sections (lines 607/608/617/1745/1755, all below the '## Unreleased' section's CHANGELOG.md:3..80 span) where the marker words are the release note's own subject matter, and 3 are inside the third-party ajv library that esbuild inlines into the committed dist/index.js (ajv internals codegen_1/names_1/propertyInData). Run B -- the gating scope, i.e. the content this feature actually authored (the 3 changed src/*.ts, the v1 schema, USERGUIDE.md, and CHANGELOG.md's '## Unreleased' section extracted verbatim) -- exits 0. `passes: true` is recorded against Run B, with Run A/A' kept in the same log so the wider scan's red state is disclosed rather than hidden. This repository configures no separate lint tool for the MCP package (mcp/sdd-forge-mcp/package.json scripts: build/typecheck/pretest/test/golden:record). `npx tsc --noEmit` is the package's static-analysis command and is recorded as the evidence for both `lint` and `typecheck`, matching the established repository precedent in specs/ci-mcp/verification/*.contract.json.
